/**
 * @throws UIMAException
 *             -
 */
@Test
public void testTable() throws UIMAException {
    String text = "Recent Results (from the past 24 hour(s))
" + "HEPATIC FUNCTION PANEL
" + "Collection Time: 12/04/15 5:40 PM
" + "    Result Value Ref Range
" + " Albumin 2.2 (*) 3.7 - 5.1 g/dL
" + " Total Protein 5.5 (*) 5.8 - 8.0 g/dL
" + " Alkaline Phosphatase 844 (*) 42 - 121 IU/L
" + " ALT 30  10 - 60 Unit/L
" + " AST 130 (*) 10 - 42 Unit/L
" + " Total Bilirubin 1.3  0.4 - 1.3 mg/dL
" + " Bilirubin, Direct 0.4 (*) 0.0 - 0.2 mg/dL
" + " Bilirubin, Indirect 0.9  0.0 - 1.0 mg/dL
" + "LIPASE
" + "Collection Time:  12/04/15 7 PM
" + // "7 PM" is covered by a TimeAnnotation
    "    Result Value Ref Range
" + " Lipase 19 (*) 22 - 51 Unit/L
" + "PROTIME-INR
" + " Collection Time: 12/04/15 7:45 PM
" + // "7:45 PM" isn't covered by a TimeAnnotation
    "    Result Value Ref Range
" + " Protime 18.0 (*) 9.0 - 11.5 sec
" + " INR 1.9
" + "COMPREHENSIVE METABOLIC PANEL
" + "Collection Time:  12/04/15 7:45 AM
" + "Result Value Ref Range
" + "GFR Calc , Female N-Blk 73 >60 mL/min
" + "Osmolality Calc 281 266 - 309 mOsm/K
" + "A/G Ratio 0.7 (*) 1.1 - 2.2
" + "RBC, UA 1 0 - 2 /HPF
" + "WBC, UA 5 (*) 0 - 4 /HPF
" + "CK TOTAL AND CKMB
" + "Collection Time:  12/04/15 10:00 AM
" + // "10:00 AM" isn't covered by a TimeAnnotation
    "Result Value Ref Range
" + "Total CK 125 30 - 240 Unit/L
" + "CK-MB 1.3 0.0 - 9.0 ng/mL
";
    JCas jCas = processLabText(text);
    assertLabMentions(jCas, "Albumin", "2.2", "Protein", "5.5", "Alkaline Phosphatase", "844", "ALT", "30", "AST", "130", "Bilirubin", "1.3", "Bilirubin, Direct", "0.4", "Bilirubin", // We are not using term subsumption, so bilubrin shows up
    "", // twice
    "Bilirubin, Indirect", "0.9", "Bilirubin", // We are not using term subsumption, so bilubrin shows up
    "", // twice
    "LIPASE", "", "Lipase", "19", "PROTIME", "", "INR", // wrong, but time not annotated
    "7", "Protime", "18.0", "INR", "1.9", "GFR", "73", "Osmolality", "281", "A/G Ratio", "0.7", "RBC, UA", "1", "WBC, UA", "5", // wrong, but time not annotated
    "CKMB", // wrong, but time not annotated
    "10", "Total CK", "125", "CK-MB", "1.3");
    // no lab mentions except in lab sections
    jCas = processNonLabText(text);
    assertLabMentions(jCas);
}
